subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all topics. The English selections are from highly authoritative sources like textbook authors (JimKurose, Ben Eater) and channels known for clear animations. The Arabic selections leverage popular educators (Hussein Nasser, Ayman Bahaa-Eldin) and focused, example-driven content. For some advanced topics in Arabic, the best available eligible video was chosen, even if it was a broader overview.
